svg.title: Swappable motion planners
svg.desc: The scheduler's motion_planning folder turns the event DAG into a solver-neutral MotionProblem; any MotionSolver in motion_planner returns a MotionPlan; one validator checks it before the action graph is built.

g.text: Proposed in Issue & proposal, Swappable motion planners. Names are proposals; the types live in motion_planner so that solvers there can implement the interface without depending on scheduler.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The same Strategy pattern as the tray and AGV solvers: the scheduler builds a solver-neutral problem, any solver behind one interface answers it, and one validator decides whether the answer is usable. CHUGG becomes one implementation among
